description: An older method of consolidating a textblock by striking the gathered sections on a stone with a heavy hammer to make the leaves lie closely together. Cockerell records this as a custom now superseded by rolling and pressing.
name: beating

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1902), Chapter V, p.80. Internet Archive.
